jobs.description:
Company Description

With more than 2700 employees Deloitte is the largest audit and consultancy firm in Denmark. We tailor solutions across Audit, Tax, Financial Advisory Services, Enterprise Risk Services, and Consulting.

Would you like to start your audit career at Deloitte's head office?

At our Copenhagen office you will get 600 Audit & Assurance colleagues across departments. We have a strong sense of community, with many joint events, from Friday bars to courses and development opportunities. This gives you plenty of opportunity to build a strong network and a foundation for where your career at Deloitte will take you.

Job Description

As an audit graduate, your day-to-day work will take place in either our Portfolio or Large & Complex departments. You will be assigned to one of our four client segments: Public, Private, Financial Services, or Top Tier and your daily work will be team-based. You will have a dedicated department manager and a coach to support your personal and professional development.

You will quickly become part of your new community and have ample opportunity to build new relationships.

As an audit graduate you:

• Always work in audit teams and be in close contact with both colleagues and clients - often working on site at the client's premises.

• Acquire extensive knowledge of your department's clients and, most importantly, the skills to advise and audit them.

• Assist in planning client's audits, coordinating efforts with, for example, Deloitte's Service and Delivery Centres, which handle many of our administrative tasks, ahead of the reporting season.

• Contribute to risk assessments of accounting areas, using your knowledge of the client's internal processes.

• Work with an experienced audit team to conduct audits to ensure that the financial statements give a true and fair view.

Your role will vary depending on which department you join but we promise that your days will not be the same. There will be room to learn, to ask for help, and to grow and take on the responsibility you want.

NEXT - our graduate development programme

When you join as an audit graduate, you enter a full-time role and will join our internal development programme, NEXT, along with around 100 other graduates across the country. You are regularly brought together for training and to prepare for new roles.

Depending on where you are in your training when you join us, you will also be studying part-time at the university. And for your first 100 days with us, you will be assigned a buddy who has been through the experience of being a new graduate and will help you settle into your new role.

Qualifications

There are several paths to become an audit graduate in our audit business. We are open to your educational background and to you completing a level of training while you are with us. The most important thing is that you have the interest and motivation to learn. And it is important that you:

• Want to develop personally.

• Are curious about auditing.

• Have social skills that will support your future relationships with clients and colleagues, and team-based working.

• Can show relevant professional experience or extra curricular activities , in which you have excelled.

• You speak and understand both English and Danish, or any of the other Nordic languages.

• You are eligible to work within the EU, either as a citizen or with the correct permits.

At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team´s success.

Even if you do not see yourself in all the bullets above, we still encourage you to apply if you believe your skills can make an impact on our team.

Additional Information

Click on "I am interested" above to apply for this position.

Please attach your CV and grades from your current and previous education. Please do not upload a traditional cover letter. Through the application process we will also ask you to answer a few questions about your motivation for the joining Deloitte.

We process applications and arrange interviews continually.

Expected start date to be 10.09.2027.

If you have any questions about the position or the recruitment process, please contact Recruitment Coordinator Emil Morelli Nørgaard on mobile: +45 53793260 or email: talent@deloitte.dk

We encourage all candidates to apply for the position regardless of, e.g., age, gender (gender identity and gender expression), sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or disability.

We look forward to hearing from you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

Commercial: You have a strong commercial mindset and understand how legal advice fits into the broader business context.

You have experience working directly with customers and are comfortable collaborating with colleagues at all levels of the organisation. You are able to balance legal considerations with commercial objectives and provide pragmatic, solution-oriented advice.

Language skills: You are fluent in Danish and English, both written and verbal.

Independent & proactive: You work independently, take ownership of your responsibilities and proactively drive matters forward.

Outgoing & interpersonal: You are outgoing and enjoy interacting with people with different backgrounds and at all levels, both internally and externally. You have strong interpersonal skills and are comfortable engaging with customers, colleagues and senior management.

You are a team-oriented colleague who contributes to a strong sense of teamwork across the organisation and is able to influence stakeholders in a constructive manner.

INVISIO’s modular and scalable portfolio includes headsets, control units, intercom systems, hubs and software designed to work together across dismounted, vehicle-based and command operations. The solutions are marketed under the INVISIO and Racal Acoustics brands.

Want to lead a small team of developers and data scientists while staying close to the code? Want real ownership of an established platform inside a growing 20-person startup? Want to enable a greener future by helping major energy companies decide where to invest in renewable energy?

Join Aegir Insights and get a unique opportunity to join a workplace where you can make a difference every day, whilst being part of a young, agile and fast-paced company.

As Head of Engineering, you will own the platform behind our products and build the engineering team that runs it.

The platform combines curated data on more than 100,000 renewable energy projects, geospatial analytics, and financial models

Built on a stack of

React/TypeScript, Python/FastAPI, MongoDB, AWS, and Kubernetes.

The role spans technical direction, hands-on engineering, team building, delivery, and building the engineering function in Copenhagen

You report to the founders and work closely with our commercial team and our in-house renewable energy experts.

• Ideally with experience leading engineers or engineering teams, while remaining hands-on in recent roles

• Have experience designing data-intensive applications, analytical systems or data pipelines, and making pragmatic decisions about performance, cost and maintainability

At Covidence Group, you’ll get to work on real marketing materials that are used by our customers, sales team and partners. You’ll work closely with our commercial organisation and get an inside look at how marketing supports an international B2B technology business. It’s a varied role where you can combine content, design, digital marketing and practical project work — and where the work you do will be visible and have a real purpose.

What you’ll do

• Get trade shows ready: Help prepare presentations, printed materials, product information and practical logistics for exhibitions and customer events.

This is a hands-on marketing role designed for someone who wants to learn by doing. You’ll get involved in the practical work behind B2B marketing — creating visual content, preparing marketing materials, supporting trade shows and helping turn ideas into something tangible. It’s a varied role where you’ll gain experience across different areas of marketing rather than focusing on just one.

• Are studying marketing, communications, multimedia design, business, or a similar field

• Are looking for a role where you can put your knowledge into practice and gain hands-on experience

• Are organised, independent and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage different tasks and priorities

• Have strong, natural English writing skills and feel confident communicating in English

• Enjoy turning information into clear, useful and professional content

• Have experience with Adobe Creative Suite is a plus

• Have some experience with content creation or document management – this is an advantage, but not a requirement

What we offer

• A paid, part-time student position in a growing international technology company

• Real responsibility from day one – your work will be used and have a visible impact

• The opportunity to build practical experience across content, design, digital marketing and B2B communications

• A varied role where you can learn, contribute and take ownership

• A small and collaborative team where you’ll work closely with colleagues across the business

• The opportunity to see how marketing connects with products, sales and customers in an international company

If you’re looking for a student job where you can create things, learn how a real business works and see the results of your work, we’d love to hear from you.

Send a CV and a short note (3–4 paragraphs, not a generic cover letter) explaining why you are a good fit for this role. If you have a portfolio or other relevant examples of your work, you are also welcome to include or share it as part of your application.
